description: This file defines an interface named CalendarSyncInterface for calendar synchronization functionality within the SuiteCRM project. It declares methods for syncing calendar accounts and meetings, managing providers and configurations, UI utilities, and scheduling, but contains no implementation details.

classes.name: CalendarSyncInterface
classes.description: An interface outlining contract methods for external calendar synchronization integration within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Syncs all calendar accounts, can be manual or scheduled.

methods.name: syncAllMeetingsOfCalendarAccount
methods.description: Schedules all meetings for a specified calendar account.

methods.name: syncMeeting
methods.description: Synchronizes a specific meeting object with external systems.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Executes a calendar event synchronization job from serialized data.

methods.name: getProviderAuthMethodWithValidation
methods.description: Retrieves the provider authentication method with validation, throwing errors on failure.

methods.name: testProviderConnectionWithValidation
methods.description: Tests the connection to a calendar provider with validation, setup, and exception handling.

methods.name: getFieldsToHide
methods.description: Returns fields to be hidden in UI based on calendar source authentication method.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Provides array of supported calendar source types.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves calendar sync configuration settings from provided post data.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves all calendar sync configuration values.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the scheduler instance responsible for calendar sync jobs.

methods.name: getActiveCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Fetches all active calendar accounts associated with a specific user.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the CalendarSync.
